title: Minimum Cost Path with Alternating Directions III
summary: Begin at grid cell(0,0), paying entrance cost1, and reach the bottom-right. Entering(i,j) costs(i+1)(j+1). Actions start at one: right/down are preferred on odd actions, left/up on even. A nonpreferred move also pays penalty at its departure cell. Waiting pays that cell's penalty. Every move or wait advances action parity. Return minimum total cost including initial entry.
officialConstraints: Dimensions1..100000; total cells2..100000; penalty matches grid shape and lies0..100000.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
